correctness.independent_verification: Exact independently implemented field-linear algebra, orbit generation and symbolic Gröbner basis computation reproduced all stated finite counts and algebraic smoothness certificates. The geometric integrality and genus arguments were separately checked.
correctness.rationale: The 20 bidegree-(4,3) monomials in H0(P1xP1,O(4,3)) evaluated at all nine P1(F2)xP1(F2) rational points give a GF(2)-matrix of rank 9; the full kernel has 2^11=2048 forms including zero. Exact independently written GF(2) evaluation and affine derivative masks gave exactly 364 nonzero forms nonsingular at all nine rational points. The four factorwise GL2(F2) substitution generators produce precisely 22 rational-smooth ambient orbits. Testing each orbit representative in the four affine charts by exact characteristic-two Gröbner ideals <f,df/dx,df/dy>, geometric smoothness is equivalent by the Nullstellensatz to unit ideals in all charts. An independent kernel/orbit/Groebner computation finds exactly four smooth orbits with representative masks 396246,399606,404886,420790 and sizes 6,18,36,6, totaling 66. The automorphism group is S3xS3 of order 36; stabilizers follow by orbit-stabilizer. Smooth positive mixed bidegree forces geometric integrality because distinct effective components would intersect; adjunction gives (4-1)(3-1)=6. This is smoothness over algebraic closure, not merely field extensions tested to a finite cutoff.

value.rationale: The binary quadric is the exceptional smallest finite-field case for minimal filling bidegree (4,3). Enumerating all geometrically smooth minimal curves and their factor-preserving ambient orbits refines existence to complete symmetry types, separating rational-point nonsingularity (364) from genuine geometric smoothness (66). These exact invariants are natural and not implied by an example or a minimal-degree bound.
